exampleEn: I’m really shooting for a promotion at work this year.
exampleKo: 올해 직장에서 승진을 목표로 하고 있어.
gameExamples: I decided to shoot for a higher score on my final exam.
When I grow up, I want to shoot for becoming a successful writer.
It's important to shoot for your dreams, no matter how big they are.
